name: Val Small
source: Val is the only daughter of [url=/c64153]Robert[/url]. A professional photographer, she lives apart from the rest of the cast in New York City. [spoiler]If the player is able to obtain Robert's best ending, Val attends [url=/c73297]Amanda[/url]'s going away party and gives Amanda her business card.[/spoiler]
